scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Briar Commons roof thermal inspection eligible for tomorrow's district visitor-badge export.
Emerging Need: A confirmed drone-vendor entry appears with its operator-authorization attachment empty, leaving a required preclearance item absent before the roster closes.
Decision Context: Early planning does not yet confirm a drone roster path; later portal and reminder records show the missing prerequisite, cutoff, and still-reversible window. The site compliance record distinguishes the needed authorization contents and SkySpan paperwork contact.
Consequence: If the attachment is not pursued before the district export seals, the inspection may remain scheduled but the drone operator will not be badgeable for the visit.

parameter.title: Briar Commons roof thermal inspection hold
parameter.description: Tentative exterior roof-window hold for thermal inspection; access method and visitor roster pending Thursday weather decision.

parameter.subject: Briar Commons scan access method
parameter.body: The morning weather check favors using SkySpan's drone tomorrow, but the district has not opened a vendor visitor line yet and the handheld backup remains possible. No operator paperwork should be chased until the roster line is visible.

parameter.content: Briar portal now shows SkySpan Aerial Imaging as the visitor vendor for tomorrow. Their insurance PDF is uploaded, but the operator-authorization attachment cell is blank. Facilities says roster attachments can be added until 15:30 today.

parameter.title: Briar Commons drone roster attachment cutoff
parameter.content: District portal attachments for tomorrow's SkySpan visitor row must be complete before the 15:30 roster export.

parameter.subject: Briar Commons visitor roster export complete
parameter.body: The 15:30 visitor-roster export is sealed. SkySpan's row still lacks the operator-authorization attachment, so that visitor entry is excluded from Friday badge production. Facilities will not reopen the export before tomorrow morning's roof window.
